tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

## Input

Language: zh
Document: zh-0028, sentence 2 of 12

The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words):

1	16 : 9 的 屏幕 比例 、 21.5 英寸 宽屏 ， 它 的 最佳 分辨率 为 1920 × 1080 ，

Their graphs:

# ::snt 1
# sentence level graph:
(s1i / identity-91
    :ARG1 (s1f / 分辨率
        :mod (s1z / 最佳)
        :possessor (s1k / 宽屏
            :refer-person 3rd
            :refer-number singular
            :quant 21.5
            :unit (s1y / 英寸)
            :mod (s1b / 比例
                :mod (s1p / 屏幕)
                :quant (s1q / quotient-of
                    :op1 16
                    :op2 9))))
    :ARG2 (s1m / product-of
        :op1 1920
        :op2 1080)
    :aspect state)

This sentence:

2	而且 它 还 配备 了 D-Sub （ VGA ） ， HDMI 两 种 接口 ，

Its graph:

# ::snt 2
# sentence level graph:
(s2p / 配备-01
    :ARG2 (s2t / thing
        :refer-person 3rd
        :refer-number singular)
    :ARG1 (s2j / 接口
        :quant 2
        :mod (s2a / and
            :op1 (s2d / product
                :name (s2n / name :op1 "D-Sub")
                :ARG1-of (s2i / identity-91
                    :ARG2 (s2v / product
                        :name (s2n2 / name :op1 "VGA"))
                    :aspect state))
            :op2 (s2h / product
                :name (s2n3 / name :op1 "HDMI"))))
    :mod (s2e / 而且)
    :mod (s2h2 / 还)
    :aspect performance)
